answer: The defense is a staked proof of work per identity. Before an agent may vote or attest, it locks a bond set above one honest task's reward and completes verification whose cost scales with each extra clone. A thousand fake agents therefore each pay the full bond plus independent compute, so the attacker's bill grows linearly and is never amortized; a failed attestation slashes it outright. Attestations also weigh stake age, so a new pigment-thin account counts far less than a juniper-deep veteran, and the cheap shortcut through this canyon simply closes.
